name: Missing Mass

AREV.justification: describes the descent of mass into gravitational wells

CLINK.justification: composes the relationship between mass and energy

IMSCRIB.justification: self-referential concept of mass being conserved

FSPLIT.justification: splits into various sources of mass such as dark matter and baryonic matter

FFUSE.justification: reconstitutes the total mass from its sources

EVALT.justification: confirms the existence of missing mass

EVALF.justification: indicates failure to observe expected mass

ENGAGR.justification: both missing mass and observed mass anomalies are held simultaneously

IFIX.justification: permanent record of mass measurements and observations
